_comment: Krea 2 Turbo with a style reference: a new image from the prompt, painted in the style of the image in Style Reference. It takes the reference's look, not its content, so it is a style match, not an edit. The style comes from ostris's krea2_style_reference LoRA, whose model card declares the Krea 2 Community License, so everything txt2img_krea2.json says about the licence holds here too: commercial use of Outputs only while company-wide revenue, affiliates included, is under $1,000,000 a year, revocable by Krea on 30 days' notice, and content filtering required. See docs/guide/licensing.md. The wiring and settings are Comfy-Org's template image_krea2_turbo_int8_image_style_reference (workflow_templates commit 3e50a92, read 2026-10-10): the reference goes in through TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus as a reference latent, FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod index_timestep_zero, the LoRA at strength 1, ModelSamplingFlux max_shift 1.15 and base_shift 0.5 at the latent's size, 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple. The template takes up to three references; this graph wires one, and image2 and image3 on the encoder take more. Its prompt enhancer is left out. DOES NOT FIT THE 16 GB REFERENCE CARD AS WIRED: on 2026-10-10, in image 0.1.11, it ran out of GPU memory in the sampler at 864x1152 and again at 672x896. The int8 weights load whole (12,867 MB) and the reference adds its own latent, which the encoder scales to about a megapixel, to every step. With --reserve-vram 2, and again with 4, the server loaded the model in part and ran out of memory sooner, merging the LoRA into the int8 weights, which turns each patched weight into a float32 copy on the card ('ERROR lora diffusion_model.blocks.25.mlp.down.weight Allocation on device'). Comfy-Org's fp8 weights (krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors) in place of int8 failed the same way at the server's usual flags: out of memory while merging the LoRA and requantising to fp8, with the text encoder still on the card. 864x1152 matches txt2img_krea2.json. Needs the krea2 weight group: scripts/fetch_models.py --download --group krea2.

inputs.prompt: A weathered stone golem overgrown with moss, a single creature standing upright, the whole figure visible from head to feet in a three-quarter view. Even flat studio lighting, a plain neutral grey background and no cast shadow. Painted game asset concept art with a crisp, readable silhouette and sharp detail.
